# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def matches_pod(left: Pod, right: Pod) -> bool:
    return left.service == right.service and left.app == right.app and left.current_node == right.current_node and left.cpu_request == right.cpu_request and left.mem_request == right.mem_request and left.stateful == right.stateful and left.has_pdb == right.has_pdb and left.image_mb == right.image_mb

def resource_headroom(requested: int, capacity: int) -> float:
    if capacity <= 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0.0
    return float(capacity - requested) / float(capacity)

def congestion(load: float, headroom: float) -> float:
    return load * load / max(headroom, 0.01)

def service_delay(load: float, share: float) -> float:
    headroom = max(1.0 - load, 0.01)
    return 3.0 * congestion(load, headroom) + 4.0 * share / headroom

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000000000.0

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000000000.0

    cpu_load = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_load = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_before = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_before = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_share = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_share = float(pod.mem_request) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_headroom = max(resource_headroom(cpu_after, node.cpu_capacity), 0.01)
    mem_headroom = max(resource_headroom(mem_after, node.mem_capacity), 0.01)
    cpu_before_headroom = max(resource_headroom(node.cpu_allocated, node.cpu_capacity), 0.01)
    mem_before_headroom = max(resource_headroom(node.mem_allocated, node.mem_capacity), 0.01)

    # Account for contention imposed on workloads already serving requests.
    queue_after = congestion(cpu_load, cpu_headroom)
    queue_before = congestion(cpu_before, cpu_before_headroom)
    memory_after = congestion(mem_load, mem_headroom)
    memory_before = congestion(mem_before, mem_before_headroom)
    queue_increase = max(queue_after - queue_before, 0.0)
    memory_increase = max(memory_after - memory_before, 0.0)

    queue_cost = 170.0 * queue_after + 260.0 * queue_increase
    service_cost = 200.0 * cpu_share / cpu_headroom
    memory_cost = 24.0 * memory_after + 50.0 * memory_increase
    memory_cost = memory_cost + 30.0 * mem_share / mem_headroom
    local_delay = service_delay(cpu_load, cpu_share)

    incoming_sum: float = 0.0
    outgoing_sum: float = 0.0
    incoming_rate: float = 0.0
    outgoing_rate: float = 0.0
    incoming_worst: float = 0.0
    outgoing_worst: float = 0.0
    incoming_path: float = 0.0
    outgoing_path: float = 0.0
    traffic_cost: float = 0.0

    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        source_matches = matches_pod(pod, ctx.pods[source])
        destination_matches = matches_pod(pod, ctx.pods[destination])
        peer: int = -1
        peer_pod: int = -1

        if source_matches and not destination_matches:
            peer_pod = destination
            peer = ctx.pods[destination].current_node
        elif destination_matches and not source_matches:
            peer_pod = source
            peer = ctx.pods[source].current_node

        if peer >= 0 and peer < len(ctx.nodes) and peer < len(node.latency_to_ms) and ctx.graph.rate[edge] > 0.0:
            latency = max(node.latency_to_ms[peer], 0.0)
            rate = ctx.graph.rate[edge]
            peer_delay: float = 0.0
            if ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_capacity > 0:
                peer_load = float(ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_allocated) / float(ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_capacity)
                peer_share = float(ctx.pods[peer_pod].cpu_request) / float(ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_capacity)
                peer_delay = service_delay(peer_load, peer_share)

            path_delay = latency + peer_delay
            payload = max(ctx.graph.payload_kb[edge], 0.0)
            traffic_cost = traffic_cost + rate * payload * latency
            if source_matches:
                outgoing_sum = outgoing_sum + rate * latency
                outgoing_rate = outgoing_rate + rate
                outgoing_worst = max(outgoing_worst, latency)
                outgoing_path = max(outgoing_path, path_delay)
            else:
                incoming_sum = incoming_sum + rate * latency
                incoming_rate = incoming_rate + rate
                incoming_worst = max(incoming_worst, latency)
                incoming_path = max(incoming_path, path_delay)

    incoming_mean: float = 0.0
    outgoing_mean: float = 0.0
    if incoming_rate > 0.0:
        incoming_mean = incoming_sum / incoming_rate
    if outgoing_rate > 0.0:
        outgoing_mean = outgoing_sum / outgoing_rate

    # Preserve rare dependencies instead of averaging away timeout-prone links.
    network_cost = 24.0 * (incoming_mean + outgoing_mean)
    network_cost = network_cost + 52.0 * (incoming_worst + outgoing_worst)
    network_cost = network_cost + 20.0 * (incoming_path + outgoing_path)
    network_cost = network_cost + 0.00002 * traffic_cost

    # Local contention compounds delays along both directions of a request path.
    path_delay = incoming_path + local_delay + outgoing_path
    path_cost = 1.0 * local_delay * (incoming_path + outgoing_path)
    path_cost = path_cost + 0.12 * path_delay * path_delay

    cpu_excess = max(cpu_load - 0.44, 0.0)
    mem_excess = max(mem_load - 0.66, 0.0)
    pressure_cost = 3200.0 * cpu_excess * cpu_excess
    pressure_cost = pressure_cost + 1000.0 * mem_excess * mem_excess

    # Activation costs apply when idle power can actually be avoided.
    power_span = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    incremental_power = power_span * cpu_share
    if node.suspended or (node.suspendable and node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0):
        incremental_power = incremental_power + max(node.power_idle_w, 0.0)

    # Energy preferences weaken continuously as contention or path delay grows.
    energy_weight = 0.30 / (1.0 + 2.0 * queue_after + memory_after + 0.08 * path_delay)
    cost = network_cost + path_cost + queue_cost + service_cost
    cost = cost + memory_cost + pressure_cost + energy_weight * incremental_power
    return -cost

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    # Remaining cumulative disruption allowances and migration-time
    # offered-request feasibility are not certified by the exposed records.
    # Preserve serving placements without consuming disruption allowance.
    return out

    return 3.0 * congestion(load, headroom) + 4.0 * share / headroom

    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000000000.0

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000000000.0

    cpu_load = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_load = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_before = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_before = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_share = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_share = float(pod.mem_request) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_headroom = max(resource_headroom(cpu_after, node.cpu_capacity), 0.01)
    mem_headroom = max(resource_headroom(mem_after, node.mem_capacity), 0.01)
    cpu_before_headroom = max(resource_headroom(node.cpu_allocated, node.cpu_capacity), 0.01)
    mem_before_headroom = max(resource_headroom(node.mem_allocated, node.mem_capacity), 0.01)

    # Account for contention imposed on workloads already serving requests.
    queue_after = congestion(cpu_load, cpu_headroom)
    queue_before = congestion(cpu_before, cpu_before_headroom)
    memory_after = congestion(mem_load, mem_headroom)
    memory_before = congestion(mem_before, mem_before_headroom)
    queue_increase = max(queue_after - queue_before, 0.0)
    memory_increase = max(memory_after - memory_before, 0.0)

    queue_cost = 150.0 * queue_after + 200.0 * queue_increase
    service_cost = 180.0 * cpu_share / cpu_headroom
    memory_cost = 24.0 * memory_after + 50.0 * memory_increase
    memory_cost = memory_cost + 30.0 * mem_share / mem_headroom
    local_delay = service_delay(cpu_load, cpu_share)

    incoming_sum: float = 0.0
    outgoing_sum: float = 0.0
    incoming_rate: float = 0.0
    outgoing_rate: float = 0.0
    incoming_worst: float = 0.0
    outgoing_worst: float = 0.0
    incoming_path: float = 0.0
    outgoing_path: float = 0.0
    traffic_cost: float = 0.0

    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        source_matches = matches_pod(pod, ctx.pods[source])
        destination_matches = matches_pod(pod, ctx.pods[destination])
        peer: int = -1
        peer_pod: int = -1

        if source_matches and not destination_matches:
            peer_pod = destination
            peer = ctx.pods[destination].current_node
        elif destination_matches and not source_matches:
            peer_pod = source
            peer = ctx.pods[source].current_node

        if peer >= 0 and peer < len(ctx.nodes) and peer < len(node.latency_to_ms) and ctx.graph.rate[edge] > 0.0:
            latency = max(node.latency_to_ms[peer], 0.0)
            rate = ctx.graph.rate[edge]
            peer_delay: float = 0.0
            if ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_capacity > 0:
                peer_load = float(ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_allocated) / float(ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_capacity)
                peer_share = float(ctx.pods[peer_pod].cpu_request) / float(ctx.nodes[peer].cpu_capacity)
                peer_delay = service_delay(peer_load, peer_share)

            path_delay = latency + peer_delay
            traffic_cost = traffic_cost + rate * latency
            if source_matches:
                outgoing_sum = outgoing_sum + rate * latency
                outgoing_rate = outgoing_rate + rate
                outgoing_worst = max(outgoing_worst, latency)
                outgoing_path = max(outgoing_path, path_delay)
            else:
                incoming_sum = incoming_sum + rate * latency
                incoming_rate = incoming_rate + rate
                incoming_worst = max(incoming_worst, latency)
                incoming_path = max(incoming_path, path_delay)

    incoming_mean: float = 0.0
    outgoing_mean: float = 0.0
    if incoming_rate > 0.0:
        incoming_mean = incoming_sum / incoming_rate
    if outgoing_rate > 0.0:
        outgoing_mean = outgoing_sum / outgoing_rate

    # Preserve rare dependencies instead of averaging away timeout-prone links.
    network_cost = 24.0 * (incoming_mean + outgoing_mean)
    network_cost = network_cost + 40.0 * (incoming_worst + outgoing_worst)
    network_cost = network_cost + 16.0 * (incoming_path + outgoing_path)
    network_cost = network_cost + 0.002 * traffic_cost

    # Local contention compounds delays along both directions of a request path.
    path_delay = incoming_path + local_delay + outgoing_path
    path_cost = 0.8 * local_delay * (incoming_path + outgoing_path)
    path_cost = path_cost + 0.08 * path_delay * path_delay

    cpu_excess = max(cpu_load - 0.48, 0.0)
    mem_excess = max(mem_load - 0.68, 0.0)
    pressure_cost = 2400.0 * cpu_excess * cpu_excess
    pressure_cost = pressure_cost + 800.0 * mem_excess * mem_excess

    # Activation costs apply when idle power can actually be avoided.
    power_span = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    incremental_power = power_span * cpu_share
    if node.suspended or (node.suspendable and node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0):
        incremental_power = incremental_power + max(node.power_idle_w, 0.0)

    # Energy preferences weaken continuously as contention or path delay grows.
    energy_weight = 0.30 / (1.0 + queue_after + memory_after + 0.05 * path_delay)
    cost = network_cost + path_cost + queue_cost + service_cost
    cost = cost + memory_cost + pressure_cost + energy_weight * incremental_power
    return -cost

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    # Remaining cumulative disruption allowances and migration-time
    # offered-request feasibility are not certified by the exposed records.
    # Preserve serving placements without consuming disruption allowance.
    return out
